pages.qa.prompt.honest: What do you honestly think of me?
pages.qa.prompt.hottake: Which opinion don't you dare say out loud?
pages.qa.prompt.never: What did you never dare to ask me?
pages.qa.prompt.rate: Give me an honest score out of 10
pages.qa.dice.1: What was your first impression of me?
pages.qa.dice.2: Which song reminds you of me?
pages.qa.dice.3: What have you always wanted to ask me?
pages.qa.dice.4: What are you secretly really good at?
pages.qa.dice.5: What could you talk about for hours?
pages.qa.dice.6: What's your most controversial food opinion?
pages.qa.dice.7: Which decision would you redo if you could?
pages.qa.dice.8: What's the kindest thing anyone ever did for you?
pages.qa.dice.10: What's a red flag you ignore anyway?
pages.qa.dice.11: Which film or show do I really need to see?
pages.qa.dice.12: What would you do with a day without rules?
pages.qa.dice.13: What's the best advice you ever got?
pages.qa.dice.14: What are you working on right now?
pages.qa.dice.15: Which talent would you want instantly?
pages.qa.dice.16: What do people often get wrong about you?
pages.qa.ask.anonymous: 100% anonymous — the recipient never sees who you are
pages.qa.ask.wandTip: Rewrite with AI so your writing style can't be recognised.

pages.qa.ask.wandDone: Rewritten. Edit it or send it as is.
pages.qa.ask.wandBasic: The AI was unavailable, so a simple filter was used. Edit it or try again.
pages.qa.ask.wandTooMany: Up to 3 rewrites per minute. Try again shortly.
pages.qa.ask.wandFailed: Rewriting failed. Your text is unchanged.
pages.qa.ask.wandEmpty: Write a message first to rewrite it.
pages.qa.ask.nudge: Heads up: unkind messages invisibly cost you your right to send.
pages.qa.ask.closed: This profile isn't taking messages right now.
pages.qa.ask.restricted: This member only accepts messages from verified ROUT accounts.
pages.qa.ask.tooMany: Easy there — try again in a minute.
pages.qa.ask.invalid: Write a message of up to 300 characters.
pages.qa.ask.noAnswers: No answers yet — will you ask the first question?
pages.qa.ask.missingBody: The profile doesn't exist, is private or has anonymous questions turned off.
pages.qa.share.title: Share on socials
pages.qa.share.howto: Post the image to your story and add a link sticker with this link:
pages.qa.inbox.title: Anonymous Inbox
pages.qa.inbox.empty: No messages yet. Share your link or story card to get started.
pages.qa.inbox.muteBody: You'll never receive messages from this person again. Nobody tells you who it is, and the sender notices nothing: their messages still look sent. This message leaves your inbox. A mute is permanent until you lift it yourself.
pages.qa.inbox.muted: Sender muted. You won't receive messages from this person anymore. They don't know they've been muted.
pages.qa.inbox.published: Published — your answer shows as a status around your profile photo for 24 hours.
pages.qa.inbox.failed: That didn't work. Please try again.
pages.qa.settings.acceptingHelp: Off = nobody can send you an anonymous message.
pages.qa.settings.onHub: As a block on your profile hub
pages.qa.settings.onHubHelp: Visitors message you straight from your profile.
pages.qa.settings.pageHelp: A full page at {{path}} — perfect as a story link.
pages.qa.settings.publishHint: Changes apply once you publish your profile.
pages.qa.settings.safety: Muted senders never find out they're muted. Anyone muted often invisibly loses their right to send everywhere.
pages.qa.meta.title: Send @{{handle}} an anonymous message
pages.qa.meta.description: Send a 100% anonymous message or question. No account needed; the recipient never sees who you are.
pages.qa.mutes.title: Muted senders
pages.qa.mutes.help: Each mute is listed with the message you muted. Nobody knows who sent it — not even you. After lifting, new messages arrive again and this message returns to your inbox.
pages.qa.mutes.lifted: Mute lifted. New messages from this sender will arrive again.
